title: Man detonated explosive device during confrontation with officers in Charlestown, police say
author: Elizabeth Mehler
bullets: Crime The man was charged with possessing and discharging explosives.
A man in apparent emotional distress detonated an explosive device he was wearing during an encounter with Boston police in Charlestown on Monday morning, authorities said.
The man, whose identity was not released, sustained serious injuries and faces charges related to the explosion, according to the Boston Police Department incident report.
